section.title: Run log
section.subtitle: Written under ~/.dsc/logs: one directory per day, rotated when full, capped in total
field.level.label: Record level
field.level.help: info records only what happened and whether it worked; pick debug to include request bodies. off stops writing to disk, including the crash line.
field.dir.label: Log directory
field.dir.help: Directories are per day, mode 0700, files 0600. Another drive is fine; it is created on first write.
field.keepDays.label: Keep for (days)
field.keepDays.help: Whole day directories are removed; today's is never deleted by its own sweep.
field.maxFileMB.label: Max file size (MB)
field.maxFileMB.help: When one process fills this in a day, it rotates to .jsonl.1 and keeps a single previous copy.
field.maxTotalMB.label: Max directory size (MB)
field.maxTotalMB.help: Above budget, the oldest day directories are removed until it fits again.
field.now.label: Current file
field.cleanup.label: Clean now
field.cleanup.help: Run the retention sweep immediately instead of waiting for the hourly pass.
save.badLevel: Level must be off / error / warn / info / debug
command.label: Log
command.description: Where the log lives and the latest entries
